chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-Mufazzal ibn Salih, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) attended a man from the Ansar, and he had a good status with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). So he attended him at his death, and he looked at the Angel of Death at his head, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'Be kind to my companion, for he is a believer.'

So the Angel of Death said to him: 'O Muhammad, be pleased with yourself and delight the eyes, for I am kind and compassionate with every believer. And know, O Muhammad, that I am present with the son of Adam at the capture of his soul. So when I capture it, a crier from his family cries out at that time. So I stand aside by the side of the house, and with me is his soul, and I say to them: 'By Allah, we have not oppressed him, nor have we preceded his term, nor have we hastened his decree, and there was no sin for us in capturing his soul.'

So if you are pleased with what Allah has done with him and you are patient, you will be rewarded and praised; and if you panic and are angry, you will sin and be burdened, and there is no criticism for you against us. And indeed, for us with you as well, is a remainder and a return. So beware, beware. And there is no family of those living in cities or in the desert, in land or in sea, except that I scan them five times every day at the times of prayer, until I am more knowing of them than they are of themselves.

And if I, O Muhammad, wanted to capture the soul of a fly, I would not have the ability to capture it until Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is the One who commands its capture. And I prompt the believer at his death with the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتِ مَدَرٍ وَ شَعْرٍ: Families living in cities and deserts
key_terms.تَلْيين: Prompting/Teaching (the testimony of faith at death)

ai.seo_question: What does the Angel of Death say to the Prophet Muhammad regarding his role in capturing the souls of believers?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Angel of Death (Malak al-Mawt) addresses the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to explain the mechanics of soul extraction, emphasizing that his role is one of mercy rather than punishment. He highlights the theological distinction between divine command and angelic execution, noting that while he is the instrument of death, he is fully dependent on Allah's will and possesses intimate knowledge of every soul's state. This hadith is significant in Shia scholarship for illustrating the gentle nature of death for the righteous and the constant vigilance of the angels in recording deeds and executing divine decree.
